hero.title: Celebrity Ascent Cruise Ship Guide
hero.subtitle: The Fourth-Generation Evolution of Celebrity's Award-Winning Edge Series
hero.description: Celebrity Ascent is a fourth-generation Celebrity Edge Series cruise ship designed around modern luxury, open-air spaces, destination-focused views, and a wide range of dining and accommodation choices. The ship entered service in late 2023 and combines the signature features of the Edge Series with updated spaces and experiences.

atAGlance.title: Celebrity Ascent at a Glance
paragraphs: At approximately 141,420 gross tons and 1,073 feet long, Celebrity Ascent accommodates up to 3,260 guests at double occupancy. This guide details Ascent's cabins, dining, deck plans, and itineraries.
Celebrity Cruises identifies Ascent as the fourth ship in its Edge Series alongside Edge, Apex, Beyond, and Xcel.

whatMakesDifferent.title: What Makes Celebrity Ascent Different?
subtitles: Celebrity Ascent builds on the design language introduced with the Edge Series rather than simply adding another conventional cruise ship to the fleet.
features: Large areas designed around ocean views
Multiple restaurants, cafés, bars, and lounges
Private suite keycard spaces at The Retreat
whatMakesDifferent.tip: Trips & Ships Luxury Travel Tip: Ascent features an expanded Rooftop Garden layout with two cantilevered pools extending over the side of the ship, compared to earlier ships in the class.

cabinsAndSuites.title: Celebrity Ascent Cabins and Suites
cabinsAndSuites.subtitle: Five primary stateroom categories designed with outward-facing perspectives and modern residential luxury.
cabinsAndSuites.intro: Celebrity Ascent offers five primary cabin categories. Inside staterooms represent the most budget-friendly choice, while ocean-view cabins swap balconies for panoramic windows. Veranda staterooms feature classic walk-out balconies, and Infinite Verandas allow you to expand your living area at the touch of a button. Suite guests enjoy private spaces and premium amenities via The Retreat.

cards.title: Inside Staterooms
cards.description: Enclosed accommodation without a private exterior view. Can accommodate up to four guests in selected configurations.

cards.title: Ocean View Staterooms
cards.description: Replace a traditional balcony with large windows overlooking the sea.

cards.title: Veranda Staterooms
cards.description: Provide a private outdoor balcony, with veranda sizes varying by category.

cards.title: Infinite Veranda Staterooms
cards.description: Allows the exterior space to become part of the stateroom through a floor-to-ceiling opening.

cards.title: Suites & The Retreat
cards.description: Suite accommodations associated with The Retreat, Celebrity's suite experience with dedicated spaces and services.

stateroomFeatures.title: All Celebrity Ascent Cabins Include:
items: Personal hair dryer and in-room digital safe
stateroomFeatures.tip: Trips & Ships Luxury Travel Tip: Booking a suite on Celebrity Ascent automatically grants you access to The Retreat's premium inclusions, including a private lounge, private sundeck, and the Luminae restaurant.

deckPlans.description: Understanding the deck layout can help when selecting a cabin. cards.title: Deck 3-5: Dining & Plaza

dining.title: Dining on Celebrity Ascent
dining.subtitle: 32 DISTINCTIVE RESTAURANTS, BARS, AND LOUNGES
dining.intro: Dining is a major part of the Ascent experience — with 32 distinctive restaurants, bars, and lounges onboard. The culinary program is divided between complimentary main dining, casual venues, and premium specialty restaurants.

profiles.name: Complimentary Main Dining
profiles.description: Celebrity Ascent features four complimentary main dining restaurants: Cosmopolitan, Normandie, Cyprus, and Tuscan. Each venue presents its own unique design, atmosphere, and selection of signature dishes, providing a variety of dining environments without the need for a single traditional dining room.
profiles.quote: Four distinctive dining venues offering rotating regional menus and signature culinary identities without a surcharge.
profiles.reason: Offers tailored signature dishes and unique architectural decor in every venue without traditional dining room crowds.
whyFits: Custom signature dishes in each venue

profiles.name: Specialty Dining
profiles.description: Ascent offers multiple specialty dining venues, including Le Voyage by Chef Daniel Boulud, Fine Cut Steakhouse, Raw on 5, and Eden Restaurant. These premium experiences focus on elevated culinary styles, chef-curated menus, and intimate designs.
profiles.quote: World-class gastronomy crafted by Michelin-starred culinary talent in intimate, upscale venues.
profiles.recommendation: Le Voyage, Fine Cut & Raw on 5
profiles.reason: Elevated culinary journeys featuring premium wine pairings and personalized tasting menus.
whyFits: Menus by world-renowned chefs like Daniel Boulud
Premium ingredients and curated wine pairings

profiles.name: Complimentary Casual Dining
profiles.description: For relaxed dining, guests can choose from multiple complimentary casual spots, including the extensive Oceanview Café buffet, Mast Grill for poolside burgers, Eden Café for light bites, and the wellness-focused Spa Café and Juice Bar.
profiles.quote: Fresh, high-quality artisanal stations, pool grills, and health-focused light bites all day long.
profiles.recommendation: Oceanview Café, Mast Grill & Spa Café
profiles.reason: Provides flexible, quick, and diverse food options from morning until late night.
whyFits: Wide variety of global food stations
Quick snacks and fresh juices available

profiles.name: Exclusive Suite & AquaClass Dining
profiles.description: Luminae at The Retreat provides a private dining experience exclusive to suite guests, featuring signature dishes curated by Daniel Boulud. Blu offers clean, spa-inspired cuisine exclusively for AquaClass guests.
profiles.quote: Dedicated culinary sanctuaries with specialized menus, private staff, and tranquil atmosphere.
profiles.reason: Exclusive keycard venues offering serene atmospheres, dedicated sommeliers, and custom menus.
whyFits: Signature dishes by Daniel Boulud at Luminae

specialtyDining.title: Specialty Culinary Highlights
specialtyDining.description: Celebrity Ascent offers additional specialty and premium culinary experiences. Menus, pricing, and reservation requirements vary by sailing.

magicCarpet.title: Celebrity Ascent's Magic Carpet
magicCarpet.lead: The Magic Carpet is one of Celebrity Ascent's most recognizable architectural features. It is a cantilevered platform that moves between different decks on the side of the ship.
magicCarpet.description: Depending on its position, it can function as an observation and social space, dining extension, or part of the pool-area experience. Its changing position means that it is not simply a fixed attraction. The experience can vary depending on the deck and operation during your sailing.

outdoorAreas.title: Outdoor Areas and Pools
outdoorAreas.subtitle: OUTDOOR LIVING & PANORAMIC OCEAN PERSPECTIVES
outdoorAreas.intro: Celebrity Ascent puts significant emphasis on outdoor living, resort-style recreation, and premium ocean views.

areas.title: Rooftop Garden
areas.description: The Rooftop Garden provides an open-air area for relaxing, socializing, and enjoying ocean views. Celebrity highlights its two cantilevered floating pools, which extend beyond the ship's edge.

areas.title: Sunset Bar
areas.description: Located toward the aft of the ship, Sunset Bar is designed around panoramic wake views. The venue combines seating, drinks, and an outdoor atmosphere.

areas.title: Resort Deck
areas.description: The main outdoor pool area provides space for swimming and relaxing, with the Magic Carpet able to become part of the pool-area experience depending on its operating position.

entertainment.title: Entertainment and Things to Do
entertainment.subtitle: TRANSFORMATIVE DAY-TO-NIGHT EXPERIENCES
entertainment.description: Celebrity Ascent is designed to offer more than traditional cruise entertainment. Its public areas change atmosphere throughout the day, with spaces that can transition from daytime relaxation to evening entertainment.
features: Grand Plaza multi-level chandelier social hub
Rooftop Garden open-air relaxation & live music
The Theatre live production shows & acrobatics
The Club lively nightlife venue & game shows
Resort Deck main pool & cantilevered floating hot tubs
The Spa & SEA Thermal Suite wellness facilities
Fitness Center with panoramic forward ocean views
entertainment.note: The Grand Plaza is particularly central to the ship's design, functioning as a multi-level social space whose lighting and atmosphere change throughout the day.

whoIsItFor.title: Who Is Celebrity Ascent Best Suited For?
whoIsItFor.subtitle: IS IT RIGHT FOR YOUR VACATION STYLE?
whoIsItFor.description: Celebrity Ascent can appeal to travelers looking for a more contemporary, design-led cruise experience rather than a ship centered primarily around large-scale amusement attractions. It may particularly suit:

cards.title: Modern Couples
cards.description: Couples seeking a sophisticated, contemporary premium cruise atmosphere with upscale dining and bars.

cards.title: Culinary Enthusiasts
cards.description: Travelers interested in world-class culinary experiences, Michelin-chef venues, and extensive wine programs.

cards.title: Nightlife & Lounge Lovers
cards.description: Adults who enjoy sophisticated cocktail bars, live jazz, DJ sets, and craft mixology.

cards.title: Solo Travelers
cards.description: Solo travelers looking for dedicated single accommodation with Infinite Verandas and no single supplement.

cards.title: Wellness Seekers
cards.description: Guests interested in thermal suites, oceanfront fitness classes, and holistic spa treatments.

cards.title: Architecture Aficionados
cards.description: Travelers who value innovative, outward-facing ship design and modern residential interiors.

cards.title: Suite Guests
cards.description: Discerning travelers seeking the exclusivity of The Retreat with private sundeck, lounge, and dining.

cards.title: Destination Explorers
cards.description: Travelers visiting marquee destinations across the Caribbean and Mediterranean on modern ships.

whoIsItFor.familyNote: Families can also sail on Celebrity Ascent, but travelers comparing it with cruise lines that emphasize large waterslides, amusement attractions, and extensive family entertainment should compare onboard priorities carefully.

itineraries.subtitle: SAILING REGIONS & ITINERARY PLANNING
itineraries.lead: Celebrity Ascent's itinerary availability changes throughout the year, so travelers should check current sailing dates rather than relying on a static list. When comparing itineraries, consider:
considerations: Number of relaxing sea days vs. port days
Specialty dining and beverage package costs

cards.title: Caribbean Sailings
cards.description: Celebrity Ascent sails popular 7- to 12-night Caribbean routes departing from convenient homeports like Fort Lauderdale (Port Everglades). The ship features sun-drenched itineraries across Eastern, Western, and Southern Caribbean ports.
bullets: Visits key ports such as St. Maarten, St. Thomas, Puerto Plata, and Cozumel
Multiple sea days to enjoy the Magic Carpet, pools, and Rooftop Garden
Ideal for warm-weather relaxation and winter getaways

cards.title: Europe & Mediterranean Sailings
cards.description: During the European summer season, Celebrity Ascent offers immersive 7- to 12-night Mediterranean itineraries visiting cultural capitals, historic islands, and coastal rivieras.
bullets: Cruises departing from Barcelona, Rome (Civitavecchia), and Piraeus (Athens)
Extended port stays in Santorini, Mykonos, Naples, and the French Riviera
Combines rich historical sightseeing with modern luxury at sea

itineraries.tip: The ship can be particularly interesting for travelers who want the Edge Series experience while visiting destinations across the Caribbean and other regions served by Celebrity.

planningFactors.title: What to Know Before Booking Celebrity Ascent
planningFactors.subtitle: BEFORE YOU BOOK: ESSENTIAL PLANNING FACTORS
planningFactors.intro: Before selecting a Celebrity Ascent sailing, compare more than the advertised cruise fare.

cards.title: Check What Your Fare Includes
cards.description: Confirm whether your selected rate includes or excludes items such as drinks, Wi-Fi, specialty dining, gratuities, transfers, and shore excursions. Inclusions can vary by fare, promotion, itinerary, and booking conditions.

cards.title: Choose Your Cabin Carefully
cards.description: Celebrity Ascent's cabin design is an important part of the ship experience. Compare the location, category, deck, view, and included amenities before selecting a room.

cards.title: Review the Current Deck Plan
cards.description: The official deck plan is especially useful when evaluating cabins near elevators, entertainment venues, pools, restaurants, or other high-traffic areas.

expertCredentials.name: Angela Hughes
expertCredentials.title: Luxury Travel Designer & Cruise Specialist
expertCredentials.quote: The Edge Series ships, including Ascent, represent a fundamental shift in how Celebrity thinks about the guest experience. It's not just about getting from port to port—it's about creating a destination onboard that competes with the ports themselves. The Magic Carpet, Infinite Verandas, and dining venues like Le Voyage are not gimmicks; they are intentional design choices that change how you experience the ocean.
expertCredentials.bio: As founder of Luxury Travel University and CEO of Trips & Ships Luxury Travel, Angela Hughes uses her personal, deep connections in the cruise industry to deliver custom cruise planning that regular booking engines simply cannot replicate.

faqs.question: What is Celebrity Ascent?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Ascent is a Celebrity Cruises Edge Series cruise ship that entered service in 2023. It is the fourth ship in the Edge Series and combines contemporary design, premium accommodations, specialty dining, and innovative outdoor spaces.

faqs.question: When did Celebrity Ascent enter service?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Ascent officially entered the Celebrity Cruises fleet in November 2023, with its debut sailing departing Fort Lauderdale on November 22, 2023.

faqs.question: How big is Celebrity Ascent?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Ascent is approximately 141,420 gross tons and 1,073 feet long, with a 128-foot beam. Celebrity lists its maximum guest capacity at approximately 3,260 based on double occupancy.

faqs.question: What class is Celebrity Ascent?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Ascent belongs to Celebrity Cruises' Edge Series. It is the fourth ship in the series, following Celebrity Edge, Celebrity Apex, and Celebrity Beyond.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity Ascent have the Magic Carpet?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity Ascent has the Magic Carpet, a movable cantilevered platform that changes function depending on its position on the ship. It can be used for different dining, entertainment, and outdoor experiences.

faqs.question: How many restaurants are on Celebrity Ascent?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Cruises describes Celebrity Ascent as having 32 distinctive restaurants, bars, and lounges. Its dining program includes complimentary main restaurants, casual venues, specialty restaurants, and exclusive dining experiences.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity Ascent have complimentary dining?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity Ascent has four complimentary main restaurants along with additional complimentary casual dining venues such as Oceanview Café, Eden Café, Spa Café and Juice Bar, and Mast Grill.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity Ascent have Infinite Veranda cabins?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity Ascent offers Edge Staterooms with Infinite Veranda, a cabin design that opens the room toward the sea and creates an indoor-outdoor living experience.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity Ascent have solo cabins?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity Ascent offers Edge Single Staterooms with Infinite Veranda for solo travelers. Celebrity says the ship has increased the number of these staterooms compared with earlier Edge Series ships.

faqs.question: What is The Retreat on Celebrity Ascent?
faqs.answer: The Retreat is Celebrity Ascent's suite-focused experience. It includes premium accommodations and access to dedicated spaces such as Luminae, an exclusive lounge, and a private sundeck.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity Ascent have a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity Ascent has multiple outdoor pool and relaxation areas, including the main resort-style pool area and the Rooftop Garden with two cantilevered floating pools.

faqs.question: What is the best cabin location on Celebrity Ascent?
faqs.answer: There is no single best location for every traveler. Midship cabins can be convenient, while travelers prioritizing views, outdoor access, quiet surroundings, or proximity to specific venues should compare the exact deck and cabin location before booking.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity Ascent have a spa and fitness center?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wellness is an important part of the Celebrity Ascent experience, with spa and fitness facilities as well as wellness-oriented accommodation options such as AquaClass.

faqs.question: Is Celebrity Ascent suitable for families?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Ascent can accommodate families, but its overall design emphasizes contemporary premium cruising, dining, wellness, entertainment, and destination-focused experiences. Families seeking extensive amusement-style attractions should compare its facilities with other cruise lines before booking.

faqs.question: Where can I find Celebrity Ascent deck plans?
faqs.answer: The current deck plans can be checked through Celebrity Cruises' official Celebrity Ascent deck-plan pages. Reviewing the current plan is recommended before selecting a specific cabin because layouts, venues, and availability can vary.
